what: A23-51 (user report 2026-10-06 + decision dc4bede): right mouse drag did not turn the camera on PC; camera = right drag only, left drag never turns it, left click = one attack. Own test Play in the main Studio (place 81671223175574, studio 4943af85), real save, no gameplay changes.
cause: Studio's device emulator was left on a phone profile (772x360, FitToWindow) in the main Studio: in Play UserInputService.TouchEnabled = true, PreferredInput = Touch and a TouchGui; the mouse is turned into Touch input. A simulated right press produced no input events at all, a left drag arrived as Touch and turned the camera (heading -2.1 -> -89.6). Not a game-code bug: no GUI sinks MouseButton2 (117-point GetGuiObjectsAtPosition grid: only the HUD buttons, quest lines and potions), no ContextActionService binding of mouse buttons, no Modal button visible, StarterPlayer camera settings default (UserChoice, mouse lock option on).
fix: StudioDeviceSimulatorService:SetDeviceAsync("default") in the main Studio (Edit) -> Play: TouchEnabled false, no TouchGui, viewport 991x487.
tools/sync_to_studio.py: after every sync, the main game place's device emulator is switched back to PC (prints the old device when it was not default).

CameraFollow.luau: the left-drag rotation is removed (no render step, no Camera.CFrame write); PrimaryClick fires on a left press on the world, once (holding or dragging never repeats). Right drag stays with Roblox's default camera.
Config.Help.CameraLine: 'Hold the right mouse button and drag to turn the camera.'

checks_before_code_change_pc_mode.right_press: InputBegan MouseButton2 gameProcessed=false; UserInputService.MouseBehavior -> LockCurrentPosition while held (the default camera's right-drag orbit engaged), Default after release
checks_before_code_change_pc_mode.left_click_old_code: 1 Swing (server counter on the Swing remote)

checks_after_sync_new_code.swings: 2 = the left drag's press (1) + one short click (1): one attack per press, never repeated while dragging
checks_after_sync_new_code.right_press: gameProcessed=false, MouseBehavior LockCurrentPosition then Default (orbit engaged)
checks_after_sync_new_code.help_window: Controls: 'Hold the right mouse button and drag to turn the camera.' (photo help_controls_pc.png)

limitation: Studio MCP's virtual mouse moves give Delta (0,0) while the cursor is locked, so the right-drag rotation angle itself cannot be measured with virtual input; a real mouse drives it (Roblox default camera code, unchanged). The user should try a real right drag once.
studio_state_after: Play stopped (my own test Play), Edit, device emulator default (PC), StudioFreshSave off.
